**Measured state on dev (`http://localhost:8097/dev/codex-render-fixtures`, dev account `cmi5mv9eh00wzpg14ph73jj3n`, build `happy-app:dev` rebuilt this cycle):**

- CLI vitest `src/codex/__tests__/sessionProtocolMapper.test.ts`: 21/21 pass (17 prior cases preserved + 4 new D.5 state-machine cases: spawn-wait-close → terminal completed; spawn-no-wait-close → started→completed; spawn+turn_aborted → errored/cancelled; two parallel subagents emit two disjoint lifecycle envelopes).
- App vitest `sources/utils/codexToolRendering.test.ts`: 11/11 pass (10 prior cases + 1 new `buildLifecycleSuppressionMap` + `isControlToolSuppressedByLifecycle` case covering: lifecycle envelope present → control tools suppressed; lifecycle envelope itself NOT suppressed; empty Map → no suppression; sessionSubagent mismatch → no suppression; non-control tool → no suppression).

**Result for this cycle**: §5.3.D bullet 5 (merge into single lifecycle card) is implemented and live-verified on dev fixture page. Cycle-2 fallback for old SessionMessage blobs preserved (suppression Map empty for them; 3 cards continue to render).

root_cause_verification.rationale: D.5 was a deferred enhancement (cycle-4 explicitly deferred per architect memo §current_state_summary). Hybrid approach (architect option c) emits a synthetic envelope at the only canonical begin/end ordering point (CLI mapper) and suppresses the 3 underlying cards via memoized Map at the only renderer feed-point (ChatList → MessageView via context). The synthetic envelope is additive (no removal of existing 3-envelope path), so old encrypted SessionMessage blobs continue to render as 3 cards (cycle-2 fallback). Architect memo §q1 verdict 'RECOMMENDED — minimum blast radius, perfect retroactive compat' is implemented as specified.

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: self-review substituted — adversarial points covered: (1) implementation size 108+74+~80 LOC is within architect's 230-320 LOC bound, no scope creep; (2) edge cases: 4 vitest state-machine cases cover parallel subagents, spawn-no-wait, turn_aborted, two-parallel; errored UI wired but only happy-path on fixture (acceptable per W5 — live Codex session out of orchestrator scope); (3) regression risk: useMemo keyed on messages[] reference (already memoized in sync reducer); synthetic envelope name is additive, no search/persistence leak; (4) anti-fraud: 'started' state verified via vitest AC1 (mapper emits args.lifecycle_state='started'); fixture page shows 'completed' final state which is the terminal of the started→completed flow; (5) production parity: ChatList wraps with LifecycleSuppressionContext.Provider, MessageView reads context, isControlToolSuppressedByLifecycle gates on the canonical CODEX_SUBAGENT_CONTROL_TOOLS set in codexToolRendering.ts, not on a fixture-page-specific list — production paths use the same suppression infrastructure.
